messages.subject: Indorama Ventures | Global sustainability, circularity and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Indorama Ventures Sustainability and Executive Leadership Team,

Indorama Ventures' global scale, circularity agenda and sustainability commitments make the company highly relevant to my experience in industrial ESG, stakeholder strategy and carbon governance.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring direct experience turning sustainability commitments into operating evidence. My recent work includes governance support around a large solar and battery-storage platform, carbon-data readiness using physical records across multiple operating sources, community and social-performance coordination, and senior regulator engagement. I am accustomed to working across environmental, HSE, legal, finance, procurement and technical teams to secure documented closure.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, ASEAN or global responsibilities across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or responsible business. I have attached an Indorama Ventures-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
